title: St Jude 2026 Recap
summary: Extended September is over and so is Relay's fundraiser this year
content:
Here we are, a week into extended September and Relay's annual fundraiser has come to a close with over $750k raised — and nearly $9k of that came from mine and Adam's campaign.

This is short of our goal of $15k that I set without really thinking much about it and it is lower than previous years. A couple of people reached out privately to apologise that they couldn't donate this year — it's rough out there. I haven't donated as much as previous years either for various reasons but to raise nearly $9k is nothing short of amazing. Everyone who shared the campaign or donated, even a small amount, thank you.

We did our usual offering of stickers this year, which expanded from a two pack into a four pack, then we added Jimothy. I offered my drawings again and once I have them all complete I will have done 32 of them, five more than last year. I'll put up a post once they've all arrived because I remembered to scan them all this year. Finally Adam decided to make his life difficult and offer friendship bracelets — he has 20 or so of these to make. Good luck.

I've started my note of ideas for next year — it's basically September already.
